format: culture- and benefits-heavy posting that names tools in company intro, culture list and perks
note: Company intro (pre-heading) and 'Life at Fernwood' (Title Case with small word 'at', followed by a list: unknown heading) are culture text: Fusion 360, 3D Printing (additive manufacturing), CNC, Technical Writing ('a culture of documentation'), Python and Machine Learning are unscored and must never be required or preferred. 'What we offer' is excluded: MATLAB appears only there. SolidWorks and Composites win their scored tiers despite culture/benefit mentions; evidence must come from the scored lines. The resume avoids all culture-only skills except MATLAB (excluded, not found). Resume: composites really negated; injection molding wraps after a comma.
posting_text:
Mechanical Engineer, Product Development
Fernwood Outdoor Gear | Boulder, CO | Hybrid

At Fernwood we believe great gear comes from people who actually use it. Our engineers take every other Friday off to climb, ski and paddle, and our design studio runs on SolidWorks and Fusion 360.

Life at Fernwood
- Monthly build days where teams try additive manufacturing, CNC, or anything else they are curious about
- A culture of documentation: every lesson learned gets written down
- Lunch talks on topics like Python, machine learning and composites

What you'll do
- Design packs, frames and hardware from napkin sketch to production
- Run FEA on load-bearing frames and buckles
- Partner with overseas suppliers on injection molding and tooling

What we're looking for
- 4+ years of consumer product design experience
- Expert in SolidWorks surfacing
- Experience designing for injection molding with DFM in mind

Bonus points
- Experience with carbon fiber or other composite materials
- You've done test-to-failure work and fatigue analysis

What we offer
- 100% paid health premiums and a $1,500 gear allowance
- Free SolidWorks and Fusion 360 licenses for personal projects
- A Python and machine learning course stipend
- A MATLAB Home license and 3D printer access
